content.text: No non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant exists anywhere in the Agreement — including the employee-related provisions (§ 13.5 Employee NDA/Invention Agreement), Confidentiality (§ 10), Miscellaneous (§ 14), and the Exhibit D personnel clause.

input.quote: This Agreement including all Exhibits, and the Non Disclosure Agreement and the Statement of Work referenced in this Agreement and incorporated by reference herein, constitutes the final, complete and exclusive agreement between the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof, and supersedes any prior or contemporaneous agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant binding Corio (or either party). Searches for "solicit", "recruit", "hire", "employ or engage", "induce ... to leave" and "employment" return nothing; the only personnel/employee provisions are § 13 (access to Commerce One personnel and the Employee NDA/Invention Agreement warranty at p0116), § 14.5 independent contractors (p0126), and Exhibit D § 5 (assignment of one sales/marketing employee each) — none of which restricts hiring or soliciting the other party's staff. The integration clause (p0133) confirms no outside document imports such a covenant into the subject matter of this Agreement. This satisfies the preferred position ("No non-solicit on Customer"), so no redline is proposed.
